# Pakistan Investment Education

> Independent educational tools and long-form guides for saving and investing in Pakistan. Figures are refreshed from primary sources; content is not financial, tax, legal or religious advice.

Pakinvestlysis is written and maintained by Abdul Ahad, a software engineer who built its public data pipeline. He is not a SECP-registered adviser. Readers should verify current figures and rules with the linked regulator before acting.

## Tools

- [Investment Comparison Tool](https://pakinvestlysis.com/): Compare National Savings, mutual funds and PSX market data, then explore a clearly labelled example allocation across broad asset categories.
- [Pakistan Tax Calculator 2026-27](https://pakinvestlysis.com/tax-calculator.html): Estimate salaried or business income tax and common sales taxes.
- [Zakat Calculator Pakistan 2026](https://pakinvestlysis.com/zakat-calculator.html): Estimate 2.5% Zakat on entered assets and liabilities using a selected nisab basis.
- [Gold Rates and Calculator](https://pakinvestlysis.com/gold-rates.html): View the current data snapshot, price history and user-defined projection assumptions.
- [Investment Backtester](https://pakinvestlysis.com/backtester.html): Compare a historical gold or PSX investment using available monthly prices.
- [SIP Calculator Pakistan](https://pakinvestlysis.com/sip-calculator.html): Model contributions using a user-selected return assumption.
- [Browser-only Portfolio Tracker](https://pakinvestlysis.com/portfolio-tracker.html): Track entered PSX, gold and cash positions without an account.

## Guides

- [Naya Pakistan Certificates](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/naya-pakistan-certificates-pakistan.html): Current SBP rates, eligibility, tenors, 10% full-and-final tax and RDA purchase mechanics.
- [Investing from the Gulf](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/overseas-pakistani-investment-guide.html): RDA, NPC, PSX and documented remittance routes for non-resident Pakistanis.
- [How to Become an FBR Filer](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/how-to-become-filer-pakistan.html): IRIS registration, return filing and ATL checks.
- [Prize Bonds](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/prize-bonds-pakistan.html): Draws, absence of fixed return, tax and comparison with savings products.
- [Gold Investment](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/gold-investment-pakistan.html): Physical formats, purity, spreads, storage and market-linked alternatives.
- [Investment Tax](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/investment-tax-pakistan.html): Withholding, dividends, capital gains and filer status.
- [Money-Market Funds vs Bank Savings](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/money-market-funds-vs-bank-savings.html): Return presentation, access, fees, tax and protection differences.
- [Opening a PSX Brokerage Account](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/open-brokerage-account-psx.html): TREC-holder checks, CDC custody, KYC, fees and first-trade mechanics.
- [Treasury Bills and PIBs](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/treasury-bills-pakistan.html): IPS access, auctions, yields, tax and rollover risk.
- [Starting with Mutual Funds](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/how-to-invest-mutual-funds-pakistan.html): Fund categories, account opening, fees and risk checks.
- [National Savings vs Mutual Funds](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/national-savings-vs-mutual-funds.html): Guarantees, liquidity, fees, tax and market risk.
- [SBP Policy Rate and Investments](https://pakinvestlysis.com/guides/sbp-policy-rate-investments.html): How policy decisions transmit to savings, debt funds and equities.

## Analysis

- [Pakistan Budget 2026-27 for Investors](https://pakinvestlysis.com/blog/pakistan-budget-2026-27-investors.html): Investor-relevant fiscal measures and their transmission channels.
- [How to Value a Pakistani Bank Stock](https://pakinvestlysis.com/blog/how-to-value-bank-stocks-pakistan.html): Balance-sheet, earnings, asset-quality and valuation framework.
- [Top Dividend Stocks in Pakistan](https://pakinvestlysis.com/blog/top-dividend-stocks-pakistan.html): A data-driven dividend screen with payout and valuation context.

## Trust

- [About](https://pakinvestlysis.com/about.html): Author identity and scope.
- [Methodology](https://pakinvestlysis.com/methodology.html): Data sources, calculations, corrections and editorial process.
- [Contact](https://pakinvestlysis.com/contact.html): Contact details.
- [Privacy](https://pakinvestlysis.com/privacy-policy.html): Data and browser-storage practices.

Primary sources include the State Bank of Pakistan, Federal Board of Revenue, Pakistan Stock Exchange, Central Directorate of National Savings, MUFAP and Pakistan Bureau of Statistics. Dates and sources on each page control over summaries here.
